description: Per-field options for a match_bool_prefix clause. Carried as the value of the field-keyed match_bool_prefix map (the map key is the column name).

query.description: Required. The text whose terms are matched, with the final term treated as a prefix. A string.

operator.description: Optional. Boolean logic used to combine the analyzed terms: or (default) or and.

max_expansions.description: Optional. Maximum number of terms the final (prefix) term expands into. Default 50.
